criteria.rationale: A focused regression breaks step advancement and requires a nonzero result naming step 2.

subcomponents.title: Complete, settled screenshot capture

criteria.rationale: The project provides a separate inspect command that launches Playwright and writes screenshot files.

criteria.rationale: The helper loops over steps, but the executable test checks only the number of files. It does not establish that each file depicts its intended step from the intended preview.
evidence: The fixture has two steps and asserts only that the screenshot directory contains two entries; it does not inspect screenshot content or step identity.

criteria.rationale: Capture waits a fixed interval without observing animation completion or consuming a transition contract shared with runtime motion.

subcomponents.title: Overlap, active-state, and attribution warnings

criteria.rationale: The focused fixture proves a scene-text collision warning, but the candidate selector excludes descendants of header, footer, and table of contents. The regression does not exercise nested chrome collisions.
evidence: The helper selects stage descendants but only the chrome container elements, then filters out elements with children. The fixture overlaps two scene spans and asserts a generic overlap warning.

criteria.rationale: The helper suppresses marked intentional overlaps while retaining an unrelated collision warning in the focused regression.
evidence: The fixture overlaps two spans inside data-presentation-allow-overlap and two unmarked spans. Assertions require an overlap warning and exclude INTENTIONAL A from output.

criteria.rationale: The helper compares rendered computed styles of active and inactive controls, and a focused fixture verifies warnings for both progress and table of contents.
evidence: The fixture forces matching active and inactive styles; assertions require both active-state warning messages.

criteria.rationale: The helper checks rendered attribution styling, and a focused fixture verifies the undersized and browser-default warnings.
evidence: The fixture sets attribution to 9px, browser-blue, and underlined; assertions require both corresponding warning messages.

demo-integration.rationale: Talk delegates orchestration to Presentation, and the shared ReferenceScene composes its scene with scene-kit primitives. The kit supplies the Stage, navigation, and node layout behavior.
evidence: Talk passes its steps to Presentation; ReferenceScene uses SceneLayer, Box, Arrow, Label, Frame, and Emphasis.

demo-integration.rationale: All nine steps are generated with the same Scene and groupKey. Stage uses those values to keep the grouped Scene mounted. Separately, ReferenceScene passes presentation-owned entity IDs to kit nodes, which use them as layoutId values.
evidence: The nine-entry outline maps every step to ReferenceScene and groupKey &#39;reference-story&#39;.
Stage keys a grouped host by groupKey when adjacent steps share the Scene.
ReferenceScene reuses entity constants across index states; Box, Arrow, Label, Frame, and Emphasis assign their id prop to layoutId.

demo-integration.rationale: The required title contract is consumed by Presentation and rendered by Header and Footer. However, the presentation-owned entity map declares a tray identity that ReferenceScene never uses: its tray is a plain div without that ID. This leaves a dead identity constant in the delivered demo.
evidence: Talk supplies title; Presentation forwards it to Header and Footer, which render it.
entity.tray is declared, while ReferenceScene renders the tray without referencing entity.tray.

demo-integration.rationale: Footer and Toc pair semantic aria-current values with stable data-presentation-active hooks. Presentation supplies and renders a project-local default attribution link, and the demo styles its attribution locally.
evidence: Active progress and section buttons set both aria-current and data-presentation-active.
Presentation defaults attribution to the made by and-scene link and renders it in a local aside.

demo-integration.rationale: The registry only maps the demo route to Talk. Talk owns the step sequence, while its scene, entity values, and CSS remain in the presentation folder. The shared Presentation boundary handles generic orchestration without demo-specific branches.
evidence: The registry lazily loads Talk for the demo slug.
Talk supplies data to the generic Presentation component; the scene implementation and styles are presentation-local.

scene-kit.rationale: Each step carries an ID, section, title, caption, scene, and payload; the active step supplies the rendered scene and narration.
evidence: Step defines these fields; Presentation selects steps[nav.index] and passes it to Stage and Footer.

scene-kit.rationale: Displayed step numbers and progress labels derive from array indexes.
evidence: Header renders index + 1; Footer labels mapped progress items with i + 1.

scene-kit.rationale: The same payload type flows from Presentation through Step to SceneProps.
evidence: Presentation&lt;T&gt; accepts Step&lt;T&gt;[]; Stage passes step.payload to Scene; the typed-payload test renders Presentation&lt;Payload&gt; with Step&lt;Payload&gt;[…

scene-kit.rationale: Stable entity IDs are used as Motion layout IDs inside a persistent LayoutGroup, and Box consumes its layout transition duration.
evidence: Box renders layout and layoutId={id} with transition.layout.duration=LAYOUT_T; Stage wraps scenes in LayoutGroup.

scene-kit.rationale: Newcomer opacity waits on a fixed delay that is separate from persistent layout completion; other primitives do not consume the Box layout timing.
evidence: Box uses LAYOUT_T for layout and ENTER_DELAY for entering opacity. Arrow, Label, Frame, Emphasis, and SymbolChip declare layout without consuming LAYOUT_T. No completion signal gates newcomer entry.

scene-kit.rationale: A focused grouped-scene test exercises ordinary conditional removal of a Box and checks that it remains mounted during exit before disappearing.
evidence: The Departing scene conditionally renders Box id=&#39;leaves&#39;; the test navigates to the next grouped step, asserts it is still present, then asserts removal after the exit interval. Scen…

scene-kit.rationale: Adjacent steps with the same group key and Scene retain the scene host and Scene keys while receiving updated step props.
evidence: Stage computes grouped from adjacent steps and uses group-based keys; the grouped-scene test changes payload and asserts the new content with one Scene mount.

scene-kit.rationale: The grouped scene stays mounted across updates, and continuing Box instances do not use newcomer initial opacity unless explicitly marked entering.
evidence: Stage keeps the grouped Scene key; Box defaults entering=false and initial=false; the grouped test asserts one Scene mount after navigation.

scene-kit.rationale: The sample explicitly composes ordered steps into one shared scene and group, with index-based changes to the entities in that scene.
evidence: Talk assigns every step ReferenceScene and groupKey=&#39;reference-story&#39;; ReferenceScene conditionally adds and updates entities by index.

scene-kit.rationale: Present mode keeps the stage and active title while removing browse narration, contents, progress, and controls.
evidence: Presentation renders Toc only in browse; Footer renders only the presentation and step titles in present mode; the mode test asserts the caption is absent.

scene-kit.rationale: Browse mode renders the active step title and caption, table of contents, previous and next buttons, and progress items.
evidence: Presentation mounts Toc in browse; Footer&#39;s browse branch renders all specified reading controls; the sample stylesheet lays out the ToC for wide viewports.

scene-kit.rationale: Mode changes update mode state without changing index.
evidence: toggleMode only calls setMode; the mode test jumps to index 1, toggles twice, and asserts index 1 remains active.

scene-kit.rationale: The window key handler maps supported forward and backward keys to next and prev.
evidence: ArrowRight, Space, and PageDown call next; ArrowLeft and PageUp call prev. The navigation test dispatches ArrowLeft and ArrowRight and checks boundary indexes.

scene-kit.rationale: Although swipe direction checks horizontal against vertical distance, the handler does not reject multi-touch gestures, and focused vertical and multi-touch assertions are absent.
evidence: onTouchStart and onTouchEnd take changedTouches[0] without checking touch count; the focused kit tests contain no vertical or multi-touch swipe case.

scene-kit.rationale: Progress buttons and table-of-contents buttons call goTo with their target index.
evidence: Footer maps each step to a goTo(i) button; Toc maps each section to its first index; the direct-jump test clicks the second progress button and asserts index 1.

scene-kit.rationale: Current progress and section controls expose semantic current state and stable active attributes.
evidence: Footer sets aria-current=&#39;step&#39; and data-presentation-active for the current item; Toc sets aria-current=&#39;location&#39; and its active attribute; the attribution and activ…

scene-kit.rationale: The presentation key handler returns when focus is on an interactive control, preserving that control&#39;s keyboard behavior.
evidence: usePresentationNav checks the event target&#39;s interactive ancestors; the focused-control test dispatches ArrowRight on a focused Next button and asserts deck navigation did not run.

scene-kit.rationale: goTo and safeIndex clamp indexes to zero, so backward navigation cannot cross the first step.
evidence: The navigation test sends ArrowLeft at index 0 and asserts index 0 remains active.

scene-kit.rationale: goTo and safeIndex clamp to count minus one, so forward navigation cannot cross the last step.
evidence: The navigation test sends ArrowRight at index 1 of two steps and asserts index 1 remains active.

scene-kit.rationale: One uniform scale is applied, but present-mode fitting assumes a larger stage area than the delivered stylesheet provides. At an ordinary 800×600 viewport, present mode computes scale 1 for a 380px canvas while the stage is only 336px tall.
evidence: getFitScale uses present top/bottom reservations of 84/72; Stage applies that scale. The sample stage retains inset 104px 48px 160px in both modes, leaving 336px of height at 600px; its mode selector…

scene-kit.rationale: The stage consumes the approved default authored dimensions of 880×380.
evidence: DESIGN_W and DESIGN_H are 880 and 380; Presentation defaults designWidth and designHeight to those constants and passes them to Stage, which sets canvas width and height.

scene-kit.rationale: Kit markup exposes stable classes and data attributes that presentation CSS can target.
evidence: Presentation, Stage, and Box render presentation-prefixed hooks; the sample stylesheet targets those hooks for chrome and entity styles.

scene-kit.rationale: The inspected kit components provide structural positioning and motion without built-in color, border, shadow, or typography treatments; the sample supplies those treatments.
evidence: Box&#39;s inline style comes from the caller and its own markup adds hooks and motion; SceneLayer supplies absolute fill geometry. The style-neutrality test checks a Box has no inline visual-trea…

scene-kit.rationale: The presentation skill permits plain CSS and instructs authors to add a styling framework only when the host already uses one or requests one.
evidence: The skill&#39;s scaffold rule says not to add Tailwind or another styling framework otherwise; its creation rule assigns visual styles to presentation-owned CSS.

scene-kit.rationale: The scene primitives accept caller positioning styles, and the sample uses explicit canvas coordinates for many entities.
evidence: Box forwards the caller&#39;s style; ReferenceScene assigns left and top positions to Boxes, Arrows, Labels, and Emphasis inside SceneLayer.

scene-kit.rationale: The kit supplies the default GitHub link but does not place its container at the bottom-right; that position comes solely from sample-owned CSS.
evidence: Presentation renders the default anchor in an aside with no positioning style. The right, bottom, and absolute-position rules are scoped to .reference-presentation in the sample stylesheet.

scene-kit.rationale: The default link and its container have stable, targetable data hooks and a container class.
evidence: Presentation renders data-presentation-attribution on the anchor and data-presentation-attribution-container plus presentation-attribution on its aside; the sample stylesheet targets the container an…

scene-kit.rationale: The top-left brand slot is empty by default and can be populated through the explicit brand prop.
evidence: Presentation passes optional brand to Header; Header renders only that value in the brand slot. The default-brand test asserts the slot has empty text.

presentation-skill.rationale: The skill requires one concise question at a time and orders missing details by topic, style, then step content.
evidence: The Gather requirements instruction says to ask the next step only after the current answer.

presentation-skill.rationale: The skill explicitly permits proceeding when the user chooses partial detail, with unknowns recorded as bounded creative choices.
evidence: The Gather requirements instruction says partial detail must not block progress.

presentation-skill.rationale: The skill directs the agent to proceed without questions when the prompt already supplies the topic, visual direction, and step content and visual intent.
evidence: The opening Gather requirements condition explicitly bypasses further questions for a complete prompt.

presentation-skill.rationale: A focused test copies the bootstrap into a fresh standalone directory and verifies that the resulting app builds, contains the canonical kit, and declares the required dependencies.

scripts/inspect-presentation.mjs: the step loop calls page.screenshot with a path under artifacts/<slug>.

verification-tooling.rationale: The supplied executable test checks the number of output files, but does not establish that each screenshot depicts its intended step from the intended preview.
evidence: tests/reference-verification.integration.test.ts: the inspection assertion checks only that the artifacts directory has two entries.
scripts/inspect-presentation.mjs: screenshots are taken after a step-index check, but readiness can accept an unrelated responder on the fixed port.

verification-tooling.rationale: Capture uses a fixed wait and neither observes animation completion nor shares a transition contract consumed by runtime motion.
evidence: scripts/inspect-presentation.mjs: capture waits INSPECT_SETTLE_MS ?? 1000 before page.screenshot.
src/presentation-kit/Stage.tsx and src/presentation-kit/nodes/Box.tsx: runtime motion specifies its own transitions.

verification-tooling.rationale: The helper omits nested chrome text from overlap candidates, and the focused fixture tests only scene span overlap.
evidence: scripts/inspect-presentation.mjs: the selector includes stage descendants but only header, footer, and table-of-contents containers; the leaf filter excludes those containers when they have children.
tests/reference-verification.integration.test.ts: the overlapping elements are scene spans, with only a generic overlap warning assertion.

verification-tooling.rationale: The helper excludes marked intentional overlaps, while the focused fixture requires an overlap warning and excludes the intentional text from output.
evidence: scripts/inspect-presentation.mjs: candidates inside data-presentation-allow-overlap are filtered out.
tests/reference-verification.integration.test.ts: the fixture contains marked intentional spans and unmarked colliding spans; assertions require an overlap warning and no INTENTIONAL A in output.

verification-tooling.rationale: The helper compares rendered active and inactive styles, and the focused fixture verifies warnings for progress and table-of-contents controls.
evidence: scripts/inspect-presentation.mjs: computed-style signatures are compared for active and inactive controls.
tests/reference-verification.integration.test.ts: the fixture forces matching styles and asserts both active-state warning messages.

verification-tooling.rationale: The helper checks rendered attribution styling, and a focused fixture verifies both warnings.
evidence: scripts/inspect-presentation.mjs: computed font size, color, and text decoration determine the warnings.
tests/reference-verification.integration.test.ts: the fixture sets 9px blue underlined attribution and asserts the undersized and browser-default warnings.
